shortDescription: Create or Delete DNS Client configuration on AOS-CX

options.name: domain_list
options.description: Domain list names to be used for address resolution, keyed by the resolution priority order.

options.name: domain_name
options.description: Domain name used for name resolution by the DNS client, if 'domain_list' is not configured.

options.name: host_v4_address_mapping
options.description: List of static host address configurations and the IPv4 address associated with them.

options.name: host_v6_address_mapping
options.description: List of static host address configurations and the IPv6 address associated with them.

options.name: mgmt_nameservers
options.description: Primary and secondary nameservers on mgmt interface. The key of the dictionary is primary or secondary and value is the respective IP address.

options.name: name_servers
options.description: Name servers to be used for address resolution, keyed by the resolution priority order.

options.name: state
options.description: Create or Update or Delete DNS configuration on the switch.

options.name: vrf
options.description: VRF name where DNS configuration is added.
